question: On a credential-free substrate class materially different from the mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class - multi-task sessions where one-time session/resource/schema discovery is amortized or cached across tasks - can an asymmetric-discovery task bank be certified ARITHMETICALLY BEFORE FREEZE (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5 on at least one task family; matched correctness >= 0.80 for all arms; a real treatment/comparator behavioural distinction; honest per-condition counters http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts; and a preregistered contamination/dynamic-range certificate) so that the bank is deliverable as a reusable substrate unblocking the flagship inheritance benchmark B2? If the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested, the mandated outcome is a bounded substrate-class negative and nothing is frozen.
hypothesis: The SESSION-BINDING-AMORTIZED class (credential-free deterministic stdlib localhost HTTP; K=8-task sessions; a 48-bit session-scoped binding revealed exactly once in the precursor task's commit receipt, absent from every idempotent channel, consumed on first use, and rejected when stale/foreign) yields a non-degenerate bank certifiable pre-freeze. Under the frozen benchmark conventions, each of F1-RECORDS and F2-WIDGETS has predicted comparator success_rate 0.875 (140/160) at novelty 0.50 and 0.75 - strictly below the 0.95 ceiling and above the 0.80 floor - and 1.0 at novelty 0.00/0.25, while T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY and PC-EXACT-REPLAY reach 1.0 at every band, with >= 2 of 3 counter dimensions behaviourally distinct between treatment and comparators. The 0.875 figure is robust across K in {7,8,9,10} (0.857/0.875/0.889/0.900, all in [0.80,0.95)).
falsifier: F-CEILING/CLASS-DEGENERACY: zero families certify, and the non-certification is comparator-attributable (in BOTH families either B-COLD-RE-DERIVE or B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate >= 0.95 at novelty in {0.50,0.75}, or a comparator success_rate < 0.80 at some band), with all validity gates passed -> the SESSION-BINDING-AMORTIZED class is declared degenerate for credential-free stdlib deterministic substrates -> bounded substrate-class negative (the mandate's honest decision-changing outcome). A treatment-side failure (T < 0.80 or PC < 1.0) or a partial result leaves the class open and maps to MIXED, not to this falsifier. F-LEAK: the one-time binding, or any value sufficient to reconstruct it, is present in any idempotent channel (/session, /task/{i}, non-receipt commit responses, all 400/409 bodies) -> NC-NO-LEAK fires -> validity-gate failure -> MIXED (not a scientific negative). F-GATE: any validity gate V1-V7 fails (nondeterminism, counter inconsistency, frozen-file change, arm protocol violation, stdlib-only breach, matched-manifest mismatch, server-enforcement failure) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a scientific reading.

substrate.class: SESSION-BINDING-AMORTIZED (materially distinct from EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 mandatory-discovery deterministic REST, which is cited only)
substrate.transport: Python stdlib only (http.server / http.client / urllib / hashlib / json), single in-process server bound to 127.0.0.1, no persistence beyond process memory, no external network, no credentials, no LLM calls
substrate.prohibition: EXECUTE must not import research/runtime/*.py or any other repository module into the measurement path (stdlib-only, frozen)
substrate.session: K=8 tasks per session; GET /api/v1/{family}/session -> {session_token, schema, epoch}; session_token is opaque (SHA-256 over server secret + family + novelty + session_index) and is NOT the binding seed
substrate.binding: one-time 48-bit value = SHA-256(server_secret, family, novelty, session_index, 'binding') truncated to 48 bits; revealed EXACTLY ONCE in the precursor task's commit receipt; consumed on first successful use; any stale/foreign/consumed value -> 400; re-commit of the precursor -> 409 and NEVER re-reveals the binding

protocol.GET /api/v1/{family}/session: create/look up session -> {session_token, schema, epoch}; never contains the binding except in the NC-MECHANISM-OFF ablation configuration
protocol.POST /api/v1/{family}/commit: {session_token, task_index, resource_id, payload} -> 200 {receipt}; 400 invalid/missing binding; 409 already-committed

novelty_semantics.0.00: schema_required=false; resource_id explicit in task spec; no chain task; all arms 1.0
novelty_semantics.0.25: schema_required=true (wire schema discovered via /session); resource_id explicit; no chain task; all arms 1.0
novelty_semantics.0.50: schema_required=true + exactly one chain task (index 5; binding revealed in task-4 commit receipt; carry distance 1)
novelty_semantics.0.75: schema_required=true + exactly one chain task (index 7; binding revealed in task-5 commit receipt; carry distance 2)

substrate.novelty_fraction: novelty = fraction of commit parameters not determined by (task spec union frozen grammar): 0.00 -> 0/4; 0.25 -> 1/4 (wire schema); 0.50 -> 2/4 on the chain task (schema + session-scoped binding), 1/4 elsewhere; 0.75 -> 3/4 on the chain task (schema + binding + >1-step context retention), 1/4 elsewhere. Band label is fixed by construction; certificate gates evaluate at novelty >= 0.50.
substrate.sample: N_SESSIONS=20 per (family x novelty x scored arm) cell -> 160 tasks per cell; 2 families x 4 bands x 4 scored arms = 640 scored sessions (5120 scored tasks); controls add the cells listed in controls
substrate.determinism: one run_seed fixed at EXECUTE; per-(family,novelty,session_index) seeds via SHA-256(seed,family,novelty,session_index); no process hash(); no wall-clock dependence in outcomes (latency recorded advisory only); a full second run with the identical seed must reproduce every per-task outcome and counter byte-identically
substrate.arm_scope: arms interact ONLY through the HTTP surface; access to server-process state, bank files or generator internals is a frozen protocol violation
substrate.benchmark_convention_disclosure: Non-degeneracy here means strictly below the 1.0 correctness ceiling under the memoryless-per-task comparator convention, exactly as in the flagged product packets. The one-time binding is a small learnable artefact, so a comparator that retains receipt context would recover it (see NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT); the certificate therefore certifies DYNAMIC RANGE (the B2 blocker), not difficulty for a memory-enabled agent. This is disclosed rather than hidden.

arms.T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY: treatment (inheritor stand-in): GET /session once per session; retain context including the precursor commit receipt; capture next_resource_id (the binding) from the receipt; commit each task once, using the captured binding at the chain task. Predicted success 1.0 all bands; per-session http=17, retrieval_calls=0, verification_calls=8, repair_attempts=0.
arms.B-COLD-RE-DERIVE: mandated comparator: before EVERY task GET /session and DISCARD prior task context (no receipt retention); at the chain task the binding is not re-derivable (one-time, 48-bit, non-leaked; ~2^47 guesses vs a 128-request/session budget) -> first commit 400, one repair re-attempt 400 -> chain task failed. Predicted success 0.875 (7/8) at novelty >= 0.50, 1.0 below; per-session http=25 (0.00/0.25: 24), retrieval_calls=0, verification_calls=9 (0.00/0.25: 8), repair_attempts=1 (0.00/0.25: 0).
arms.B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED: mandated comparator: identical request pattern to cold PLUS one local retrieval_call per task over the frozen prior-session store (8/session); at the chain task it retrieves the binding recorded in a DIFFERENT session (stale within this session's registry, server-enforced) -> 400 -> fail. Predicted success 0.875 at novelty >= 0.50, 1.0 below; per-session http=25 (0.00/0.25: 24), retrieval_calls=8, verification_calls=9 (0.00/0.25: 8), repair_attempts=1 (0.00/0.25: 0).
arms.PC-EXACT-REPLAY: positive control: golden-input executor given the session's exact binding and schema by frozen construction (no HTTP discovery); proves the substrate is completable and scoring is non-degenerate. Predicted success 1.0 all bands; per-session http=17, retrieval_calls=0, verification_calls=8, repair_attempts=0.

null_control.role: mechanism ablation and negative-branch witness: the one-time-ness of the binding is disabled (the binding is also exposed by /session, i.e. symmetric re-derivable discovery) with the identical task bank and arm policies
null_control.expected: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED both reach 1.0 at novelty >= 0.5 -> the certificate procedure returns FALSE -> proves the certificate can fire negative and that the one-time asymmetric mechanism, not the bank content or the arm definitions alone, produces the dynamic range

controls.NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT: T minus context retention (captures the receipt then discards it before the chain task). Expected 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5, 1.0 below. Isolates retention as the operative distinction between T and the comparators.
controls.NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING: T with a binding valid in ANOTHER session of the same family; server rejects (400). Expected 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5. Proves session-scoping is server-enforced.
controls.NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION: T with a binding drawn from the OTHER family; server rejects. Expected 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5. Proves family isolation.
controls.NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT: spec-only actor: uses only task specs, no /session, no schema, no receipts. Expected 1.0 at novelty 0.00, 0.0 at novelty >= 0.25. Proves the correct action is NOT determined by the spec alone and that discovery is genuinely required.
controls.NC-NO-LEAK: mechanical scan of EVERY idempotent response body (/session, /task/{i}, non-receipt commit responses, all 400/409 error bodies) for the binding and for any value sufficient to reconstruct it (the receipt is the sole permitted occurrence, exactly once) plus recomputation of binding entropy (48 bits, >= 40-bit floor). A single hit -> F-LEAK -> MIXED.
controls.NC-EQUAL-BUDGET: every arm operates under the same 128-request/session ceiling (max predicted usage 25); no arm is starved; the budget never binds (failure is therefore not budget-induced).
controls.NC-NO-SYNTHETIC: the server returns no hints or assistive values (no edit-distance feedback, no partial credit); scoring is exact match of final committed state against the deterministic ground-truth manifest.
controls.NC-ARM-BLIND-SCORING: the scorer is a pure stateless function over (task_index, final_committed_state) rows only; it never sees arm identity, arm traces, retrieval-store contents or counters. Verified by frozen interface contract.
controls.NC-DOUBLE-RUN: the full scored matrix is executed twice with the same run_seed; every per-task outcome and counter must be byte-identical; any divergence -> validity-gate failure (MEASUREMENT_INVALID).
controls.NC-COUNTER-INTEGRITY: all four counters are re-derived from one interleaved execution trace with monotonic request ids. Frozen invariants: http_requests == session_gets + task_reads + commit_requests; verification_calls == commit_requests; repair_attempts <= verification_calls; retrieval_calls == 0 for all arms except B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED. Re-derivation must match the reported counters exactly.
controls.NC-K-SWEEP: the construction is re-run at K in {7,8,9,10} with the identical mechanism; the certificate must remain non-degenerate at every K (comparators in [0.80,0.95)). Proves the 0.875 result is not a knife-edge artifact of K=8.
controls.NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT: solvability/depth witness (diagnostic, NOT a gate): a cold-by-policy actor that retains EXACTLY the immediately-prior task's receipt. Expected 1.0 at novelty 0.50 (carry distance 1) and 0.875 at novelty 0.75 (carry distance 2 exceeds 1-step retention). Proves the chain task is completable (substrate not impossible) and that the benchmark measures a real, memory-depth-sensitive discovery-and-carry mechanism, not a rigged impossibility.

counters.http_requests: every HTTP request issued by the arm (success, failure, repair re-attempts), from the single trace
counters.retrieval_calls: local retrieval invocations over the frozen prior-session store (B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED only)
counters.verification_calls: commit requests issued = ground-truth checks performed (includes repair re-attempts)
counters.repair_attempts: commit requests issued after an initial failure on the same task
counters.predicted_per_session_band_specific: T/PC all bands: http=17, retr=0, verif=8, repair=0. COLD novelty 0.00/0.25: http=24, retr=0, verif=8, repair=0; novelty 0.50/0.75: http=25, retr=0, verif=9, repair=1. RETRIEVAL novelty 0.00/0.25: http=24, retr=8, verif=8, repair=0; novelty 0.50/0.75: http=25, retr=8, verif=9, repair=1.

contamination_controls.cache_vs_test_ids: T's retained context contains only {session schema, explicit spec-derived resource ids, the current session's receipt}; B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED's store contains ONLY values from sessions OTHER than the current one (frozen prior-session store); no arm receives the current session's binding except through the single server-issued receipt (T/PC).
contamination_controls.server_enforced: the server validates every resource_id against the live session registry and consumes the binding on first use; stale/foreign/consumed -> 400 (verified by NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING, NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION, NC-NO-LEAK).
contamination_controls.matched_manifests: identical task manifests per (family, novelty) across ALL arms; arms differ ONLY in frozen policy, never in stimuli.
contamination_controls.cache_only_oracle: a store-only/cache-only actor completes 0 tasks at novelty >= 0.25 (behavioral proxy NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT); no test-session answer is obtainable from any store.
contamination_controls.arm_blind_scoring: the scorer sees only (task_index, final_committed_state) rows; no arm identity, traces, stores or counters.

measurement_validity.validity_class: deterministic closed-form construction measurement on a frozen-literal bank; no LLM, no stochastic model, no network beyond loopback
measurement_validity.gate_classes: Two classes are separated. VALIDITY GATES (V1-V7) decide whether the measurement is interpretable at all. SCIENTIFIC RATE MEASUREMENTS (per-cell arm success rates) are genuine measured outputs and are NOT equality-frozen; a measured rate that differs from the pre-freeze prediction is evaluated by the decision rule, never auto-classified as invalid, unless it co-occurs with a V1-V7 failure.
validity_gates: V1: packet immutability (frozen request/spec/prereg/design_review untouched) and stdlib-only measurement path
V2: NC-DOUBLE-RUN byte-identical per-task outcomes and counters
V3: NC-NO-LEAK clean and binding entropy recomputed >= 40 bits
V4: NC-COUNTER-INTEGRITY trace re-derivation matches the reported counters
V6: matched manifests across arms and no arm protocol violation
V7: NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING and NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION confirm server-enforced session/family scope and binding consumption
measurement_validity.representation_loss: executors are deterministic stand-ins for real agents; the certificate certifies the SUBSTRATE's dynamic range under the frozen benchmark conventions, not any real-agent capability. Real-agent economics remain for the B2 benchmark to measure on this bank.

threats.circularity_substrate_vs_arm: addressed by NC-MECHANISM-OFF (disabling only the one-time mechanism, with identical bank and arms, flips the comparators to 1.0 and the certificate to FALSE), by NC-NO-LEAK + 48-bit entropy (the non-re-derivable property is mechanically verified over the HTTP surface), and by the information-theoretic argument that the comparator policy is the mandate-named benchmark convention and its per-chain-task failure is forced by 48 bits of unrecoverable state, not by an arm-tuning choice.
threats.ceiling_baselines: both comparators are predicted at 0.875, 0.075 below the 0.95 ceiling and 0.075 above the 0.80 floor; the excluded REST class is cited, NOT re-run.
threats.floor_baselines: NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT anchors the true floor at 0.0 for novelty >= 0.25, so 0.875 is not a floor artifact.
threats.treatment_comparator_identity: T, COLD and RETRIEVAL differ in frozen policy and in predicted success rate and every counter dimension; identity collision is impossible unless a validity gate fails.
threats.contamination: see contamination_controls; scored via server-enforced validation plus the cache-only-actor proxy.
threats.nondeterminism: single run_seed, no process hash(), no wall-clock dependence, double-run gate.
threats.learnability_of_binding: disclosed in substrate.benchmark_convention_disclosure and measured by NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT: the 0.875 comparator rate is relative to the memoryless-per-task convention, and the benchmark certifies dynamic range, not difficulty for a memory-enabled agent.

decision_rule.family_certifies: A family certifies iff, at novelty >= 0.50, B-COLD-RE-DERIVE < 0.95 AND B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED < 0.95, AND every scored arm (T, COLD, RETRIEVAL, PC) has success_rate >= 0.80 at every band, AND behavioural distinction holds (>= 2 of 3 counter dimensions distinct between T and each comparator AND success margins T-COLD >= 1/8 and T-RETRIEVAL >= 1/8 at novelty >= 0.5).
decision_rule.SUPPORTS: >= 1 family certifies AND all controls equal their predicted values (PC=1.0; NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT=0.875; NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING=0.875; NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION=0.875; NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT 1.0 at 0.00 / 0.0 at >= 0.25; NC-MECHANISM-OFF -> FALSE) AND validity gates V1-V7 pass -> deliver the certified bank (task manifests, stdlib HTTP protocol, executor policy definitions, scored evidence, contamination certificate) as a reusable substrate for the B2 benchmark; C-MEAS-VALID substrate-validity evidence only, no status change, no promotion.
decision_rule.FALSIFIES: zero families certify AND the non-certification is comparator-attributable - in BOTH families either a comparator success_rate >= 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5 (the certificate is unsatisfiable on the frozen class) or a comparator success_rate < 0.80 at some band (the bank is below floor) - AND validity gates V1-V7 pass AND every control equals its predicted value -> bounded substrate-class negative: the SESSION-BINDING-AMORTIZED class is closed for credential-free stdlib deterministic substrates -> flag the Global Director that the flagship benchmark class requires credentialed substrates or a changed product thesis (the mandate's stated honest decision-changing outcome). Reachability witness: the pre-registered NC-MECHANISM-OFF configuration ablates ONLY the one-time mechanism from the identical substrate, bank and arm policies, and under the frozen certificate it returns unsatisfiable (comparators 1.0 >= 0.95 -> FALSE), so the negative branch is demonstrably inhabited and the procedure is non-vacuous; any realized degeneration of the mechanism-intact frozen class (comparators at/above ceiling) triggers this same branch at measure time.
decision_rule.MIXED: Validity gates V1-V7 pass and the classification is neither SUPPORTS nor FALSIFIES: exactly one family certifies while the other fails (partial dynamic range); OR a treatment-side failure (T < 0.80 or PC < 1.0) makes the bank undeliverable without closing the substrate class; OR a control does not equal its predicted value (e.g., NC-NO-LEAK fires -> F-LEAK, or NC-MECHANISM-OFF fails to flip to FALSE); OR the solvability witness NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT = 0.0 at novelty 0.50 (chain task unreachable by ANY memory actor -> substrate-solvability failure). NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT is otherwise a NOT-a-gate diagnostic: its other deviations are reported but do not by themselves change the classification -> the bank is not deliverable as certified; emit the exact repair list.
decision_rule.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: any validity gate V1-V7 fails (infrastructure failure, double-run divergence, counter inconsistency, frozen-file modification, arm protocol violation, stdlib-only breach, matched-manifest mismatch, server-enforcement failure) -> no scientific reading; record the diagnosis and the smallest unblocking next action. Infrastructure/substrate failure is never encoded as scientific falsification.
decision_rule.consequence_positive: The flagship inheritance-economics benchmark B2 is unblocked by a certified, credential-free, deterministic, zero-model-cost bank whose comparators sit off-ceiling (0.875), whose amortized inheritor is on-ceiling (1.0), and whose treatment counters are strictly lower (http 17 < 25, repair 0 < 1, retrieval 0 < 8).
decision_rule.consequence_negative: A bounded substrate-class negative is recorded, turning 'B2 blocked' into 'B2 class closed on the credential-free stdlib one-time-session substrate family' and forcing the credentialed-substrate or thesis-change decision; the freeze-nothing escape clause is preserved for any unsatisfiable variant.

product_consequence_positive: Runtime delivers a certified, reusable asymmetric-discovery task bank (frozen manifests, stdlib HTTP protocol, executor policy definitions, scored evidence, contamination certificate) that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark B2: external agents can be benchmarked on a substrate where cold re-derivation and retrieval-shaped baselines score 0.875 (off the 1.0 ceiling, above the 0.80 floor) while an amortized inheritor scores 1.0 at strictly lower http/verification/repair cost. No product promotion and no claim status change; C-MEAS-VALID substrate-validity evidence only, bounded to two task families on a credential-free stdlib substrate.
product_consequence_negative: If zero families certify, record a bounded substrate-class negative for the SESSION-BINDING-AMORTIZED class: credential-free stdlib deterministic substrates with one-time session-scoped discovery cannot deliver benchmark dynamic range; the flagship B2 class is closed on this substrate family and the factory must seek credentialed substrates or change the product thesis. Nothing is promoted and no claim is advanced. If a validity gate fails, deliver the exact repair list instead of a bank.

expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in both extremes. Positive: the flagship B2 benchmark (currently gated on benchmark degeneracy: cold/retrieval at the 1.0 ceiling on the tested class) receives a certified non-degenerate substrate. Negative: the certification attempt closes the credential-free stdlib one-time-session substrate family with a bounded negative, forcing the credentialed-substrate or thesis-change decision instead of further degenerate benchmark cycles. This packet also corrects the prior attempts' structural defect (an equality gate on every cell that made the falsifying branch unreachable) by separating validity gates from genuine scientific rate measurements, so both branches are reachable at measure time; it adds a K-sweep robustness control and a solvability/depth witness, and it discloses the memoryless-convention boundary of the certificate.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: All four branches are arithmetically reachable and were re-verified with an executed rule-level probe. SUPPORTS: both families are predicted to certify (comparators 0.875 in [0.80,0.95), T/PC 1.0, distinction 3/3). FALSIFIES: the certificate procedure is a non-vacuous check that demonstrably returns FALSE - the pre-registered NC-MECHANISM-OFF configuration ablates only the one-time mechanism from the identical substrate, bank and arms and drives both comparators to 1.0 >= 0.95 -> certificate FALSE; the excluded REST class independently returned the same FALSE. The primary comparator rates are measured outputs, not equality-frozen, so any realized degeneration of the mechanism-intact class maps to FALSIFIES rather than to invalidity. MIXED is reachable via NC-NO-LEAK firing, a control failing to discriminate, a treatment-side failure, or exactly one family certifying. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via any validity gate V1-V7 failure.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is present now. python3 3.12.15 is installed; http.server/http.client/urllib.request/hashlib/json import successfully; a live in-process stdlib HTTPServer on 127.0.0.1 answered urllib GET /session with HTTP 200 JSON, POST commit with the valid binding -> 200 (revealing next_resource_id once), a repeated POST with the same consumed binding -> 409, a POST with a wrong binding -> 400, and a POST with a missing binding -> 400. No credentials, browser, dataset, external endpoint or model access is required; determinism comes from a frozen run_seed with no process hash() and no wall-clock dependence in outcomes. There is no prerequisite that is deferred to EXECUTE.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The two comparators are distinct frozen policies with distinct predicted counter profiles (retrieval 0 vs 8) and identical off-ceiling predicted success 0.875 at novelty >= 0.5, against T/PC 1.0 and against the 1.0 low-novelty band. They are identifiable against the ceiling (0.875 < 0.95), against the floor (0.875 >= 0.80), against each other (retrieval dimension), and against the treatment (success margin 0.125 and three distinct counter dimensions). The 0.95 ceiling is the mandate's own threshold; the excluded REST class is cited as the degenerate reference and is not re-run. The floor is independently anchored at 0.0 by NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT. No arm pair is guaranteed identical, and the K-sweep shows the comparator rate is not pinned to a single construction parameter.

control_sensitivity.reason: Each control has a distinct predicted value detecting a distinct failure mode, and the probe verified them: PC-EXACT-REPLAY 1.0 (substrate completable, scorer non-degenerate); NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT 0.0 at novelty >= 0.25 (discovery genuinely required, floor anchored); NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT 0.875 (retention is the operative T property, exactly -0.125 vs T); NC-SHUFFLED-BINDING 0.875 and NC-FAMILY-ISOLATION 0.875 (server-enforced scope); NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT 1.0 at 0.50 / 0.875 at 0.75 (substrate solvable and memory-depth-sensitive); NC-MECHANISM-OFF flips the certificate to FALSE (the negative branch is inhabited at measure time); NC-K-SWEEP non-degenerate at K in {7,9,10}; NC-NO-LEAK + entropy >= 40 bits; NC-DOUBLE-RUN (determinism); NC-COUNTER-INTEGRITY (honest counters). No control is tautological or impossible.

treatment_liveness.reason: T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY is a deterministic stdlib actor whose exact control flow (bootstrap /session once, retain context, capture next_resource_id from the precursor receipt, commit each task once with the captured binding) was executed in the rule-level simulation and reached 1.0 with the predicted counter vector; the transport it depends on was proven live by the real loopback HTTP probe. This is a measurement-substrate treatment (a benchmark inheritor stand-in), not a SPIDER-kernel integration, so no kernel dependency gates it. EXECUTE additionally enforces liveness through PC parity (T must equal PC at 1.0; a broken capture loop drops T and trips the distinction gate) and through NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT.
